youtubeFindings.title: Jerry and Marge Go Large: 60 Minutes' original story on the Selbees' lottery loophole
youtubeFindings.finding: Documents a legal historical lottery rolldown in which published prize redistribution rules created positive expected value at sufficient ticket volume. This is a strong precedent for EDGE's search strategy: exploit published payoff-rule discontinuities, not number prediction.
